note: PRIMARY DELIVERABLE (v2, after 5 improvement loops): delta-neutral funding-rate harvest, tuned. Robust, market-neutral crypto edge. Walk-forward OOS at 1x: Sharpe 9.4, ann +13.5%, win-days 77%, max DD -0.31%. Leverage is the return dial (market-neutral): at 8x the 0.25%/day target is MET (0.278%/day) with DD only -2.5%. v1 (research/funding_harvest.py) had OOS Sharpe 4.8 / ann 5.8% -> v2 roughly doubles Sharpe and hits the daily target at ~1/3 the drawdown. See RAPPORT_DAYTRADING.md.
data_source: Binance Vision public dumps (funding + perp/spot 8h klines), data/cache/vision_* (~55 coins)
what_improved: Loop 1: fixed-slot equal-weight deployment (stable, low turnover) beat active-rebalance and beat funding-weighted/top-N concentration (diversification wins).
Loop 2: broadened universe from 24 -> ~55 liquid perps (more deployment + diversification). Biggest single gain.
Loop 3: static leverage is the clean return dial (vol-targeting did not help); leverage sweep provided.
Loop 4: 24-period mean funding forecast + basis-consistency filter (only take the leg the perp-spot basis supports); longer lookback cut whipsaw.
Loop 5: walk-forward + cost-stress confirmed robustness; params stable across all folds (not overfit).
mechanics: Per coin, market-neutral: collect POSITIVE funding via short-perp+long-spot; collect NEGATIVE funding via long-perp+short-spot. Hysteresis entry (enter only when 24-bar mean funding beats the cost hurdle) + basis filter + hold until decay -> low turnover. Equal weight across active coins, fixed 12 slots (idle capital when < 12 qualify).
